claims: check_model calls ps2_sections.parse, obtains each record's parser-derived expanded_24 span, and validates that every measured span has 32-byte rows and stays within the file bounds.

The verifier checks only little-endian binary32 values at serialized offsets +0x04, +0x08, +0x0c, and +0x10, classifies NaNs and signed infinities from exponent/fraction bits, and ignores adjacent unmapped fields.
Corpus mode binds files to the archive baseline, applies the two explicitly SHA-bound measured legacy profiles, and checked all 56 model files to exact EOF.
